answer: Probationary vesting ladder: a new identity earns rewards only into a locked ladder, not spendable cash. Each epoch it completes one verified task and one rung unlocks; after twelve verified epochs the ladder opens. Three peers re-run every task, and one failed audit forfeits the ladder and freezes the identity three epochs. A velvet-gloved farm cannot shortcut this: to forge 1,000 identities means 12,000 tasks across twelve epochs before any full payout, about 4,000 GPU-hours, while one honest agent spends twenty minutes on one task per epoch and watches its lantern grow rung by rung.
